XECH – BlendX Portable Blender

Portable Blender designed to crush Ice: A powerful motor adapted to crushing ice for frozen fruits to prepare the perfect smoothies or protein shakes on the go!

Make Silky Smoothies with 6 Multi-Angled Stainless Steel Blades: Engineered to crush frozen fruits, and nuts like almonds, walnuts, ice, and even make coconut milk thanks to powerful steel blades.

Designed to blend and juice: Prepare Protein Shakes, Smoothies, Milkshakes, Fruit Drinks, Health Food Drinks, Iced Lattes, Baby Food, Dips & Sauces, Cocktails & Mocktails

One Button Operation: Preparing your favourite is super easy. Simply add water or milk, the fruits and protein powder and ice and blend away!

Self Cleaning: Even cleaning is super easy. Just add water and a drop of soap, blend, and your blender is clean in seconds—hassle-free and ready to use again.

Handheld and Light Weight: Great for on the go blending to get the freshest smoothies. Large 500ml capacity for the right quantity to sustain your healthy lifestyle.

Features: Crush Ice | Rechargeable Battery | One Button Operation | 6 Stainless Steel Blades | Self Cleaning | Portable and Compact | Safety Cut-Off Mechanism | Quiet Operation | Easy to Carry Lanyard | BPA Free

Product Specifications: Capacity: 500ml | Voltage: 7.4v | Charging Type: USB C | Product Dimensions: 8cm x 23cm 9cm | Item Weight: 630g

APPLICATIONS

  • Protein Shakes
  • Smoothies
  • Milkshakes
  • Fruit Drinks
  • Health Food Drinks
  • Iced Lattes
  • Baby Food
  • Dips & Sauces
  • Cocktails & Mocktails
  • MOQ- 100 Pc.
